description: This procurement is a Small Business Set Aside. Email quotes to kaitlin.h.summerville.civ@us.navy.mil on or before the closing date and time of Wednesday 4 March 2026 11am Central Time. The Government will not accept late quotes. Provide cage code and Lead time on your quote. Be able to invoice through Wide Area Workflow (WAWF). IF shipping is not included in the price please include a line item for shipping. See the attached document for the product description and quantity. Award will be based on the best value to the government considering price, delivery, quality, and past performance. Please review all attachments.
